notes.title: Build 0.6.7.h2 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]This update is live for both the game and demo versions.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Improvements[/b][/h2][p]- Changed how the decoration cap is calculated to be more dynamic, now scaling with the store size.[/p][p]- Restock workers now prioritize shelves with the least items first.[/p][p]- Added discounted packages for miniatures.[/p][p]- Added a capacity display on the left to show a shelf's capacity.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p]- Fixed the furniture 2 perk description being outdated.[/p][p]- Fixed the price setting display not selecting the correct icon for miniatures.[/p][p]- Fixed purchased tiles counter not being reset when going back to menu without quitting, resulting in increased store expansion prices.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with the broom not getting unfocused if picked up by worker while highlighted by the player.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue causing storage workers to get stuck while leaving at the end of the day.[/p][p][/p][p]//[/p]

notes.title: Build 0.6.7.h1 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2][b]Notable improvements[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Slightly adjusted the demand impact on customer buy chance so that lower demand items are being considered slightly more.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added a demo build which is currently under review. Full announcement when it is available for download.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue causing thieves to not despawn when reaching the edge of the map while running away with items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing thieves to leave with stolen items without running away.[/p][/*][*][p]Market category for miniatures is now clickable.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]//[/p]

notes.title: Build 0.6.7 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][i][b]This is the last planned content update before the early access release, coming early October![/b][/i] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Miniatures![/h3][p]As the last planned item for the initial early access release, miniatures are now available for purchase![/p][p]Like all the other items, they can be unlocked through the perk tree.[/p][p][/p][p]There are currently 3 sets available, each set containing 4 individual miniatures.[/p][p]Finally, unlocking a miniature set perk also unlocks new decoration statues that match the miniature set.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Inventory App Overhaul[/h3][p]A new perk has been introduced that will allow the player to unlock the inventory app.[/p][p]The inventory app has been made more useful through the following additions:[/p][p]- All the items that are currently unlocked are displayed in the inventory app, regardless of them being in stock or not.[/p][p]- In addition to being able to set the price, players can also order items directly from the inventory app.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Improvements[/b][/h2][p]- Added a new "Shelf Settings" panel. [/p][p]    [i]Currently, the only setting is the ability to block restocking on a shelf. [/i][/p][p][i]    In the future, this panel will be expanded to include more settings.[/i][/p][p]- Adjusted the leveling curve to be slightly more lenient, especially in the early game.[/p][p]- Adjusted customer spawn ratios to be slightly higher, mostly impacting the early game.[/p][p]- Adjusted the checkout speed review type to be slightly less lenient.[/p][p]- Doubled npc name lists as well as the passerby action lists. (No more "Walking the dog" action, I'm afraid)[/p][p]- Added credits to main menu and discord link button in the patch notes panel.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p]- Fixed some issues causing items not being placed correctly in build mode.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the inventory app would not update when items were added or removed.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue causing music volume to change unexpectedly when playing a new music track.[/p][p]Plus many other small fixes![/p][p][/p][p]//[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Build 0.6.5.h1 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]This is a build to address some of the more prominent issues found in the latest beta test![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Improvements[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]- Added neutral reviews. This makes it so if values are only slightly negative/positive, customers will instead leave a neutral review.[/p][p]- Slightly boosted plant decoration value.[/p][p]- Made variety reviews a little more lenient for early game.[/p][p]- Made litter chance code more reliable.[/p][p]- Added a 20s cooldown for customer litter chance (Chance roll every 20s).[/p][p]- The checkout can now be moved even if there are customers in the queue.[/p][p]- The player can now take over a checkout from cashier workers, causing them to go idle.[/p][p]- Added sound fx for right-clicking on npcs.[/p][p]- Added a "max buy attempts" value to customers. This is to reduce the store's overcrowding.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p]- Fixed a value mismatch for decor score of clearing trash piles.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that prevented workers cleaning not counting towards the decor score.(Trash piles would add permanent impact)[/p][p]- Fixed in-game guide not scaling well in ultra-wide resolutions.[/p][p]- Fixed the customer info panel overlapping when in build mode.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue preventing wall and floors from being saved correctly.[/p][p]- Fixed transparent walls not being set back to customized material.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that would reset the wall/floor materials even if purchased.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with some walls not turning transparent when the player is behind them.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue preventing staff live actions from being displayed in the info panel.[/p][p]- Greatly improved staff spawning mechanics, making them less prone to issues.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue causing the workers to not drop the broom when fired.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue causing the workers to leave with the broom in hand when the day ended.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that would keep a box highlighted by the player when picked up by the staff.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that would make stolen items be ignored by the Inventory manager, resulting in negative values.[/p][p]- Temporarily removed outline to selected npcs. (This will be re-enabled in a future patch)[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with control popup bindings not updating after rebinding a key.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue preventing the player's highlighted object not resetting when going back to menu.[/p][p][/p][p]//[/p]

notes.title: Build 0.6.5 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Global Market[/h3][p]There is a new app in the phone interface called "Global Market".[/p][p][/p][p]- With this app, players can now visualize the demand for every item in the game.[/p][p]- Customers are a lot more likely to buy items that are in high demand.[/p][p]- The demand varies every in-game day, so make sure to check back before planning your restocks.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]In-Game Guide[/h3][p]You can now access a series of in-game guides from the settings or from buttons marked with a question mark.[/p][p][/p][p]The new guides include mechanics that are not covered in the initial tutorial, such as:[/p][p]- Staff Management[/p][p]- Store Rating[/p][p]- Global Market[/p][p]- Cleaning the Store[/p][p]- Thieves[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Add pulse animation to the build button counter when new furniture is deposited on the pallet.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated cursor graphic.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced staff speed perk increment from 0.5 to 0.4. (They were zooming a little too much.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added checkout "reservation" to avoid multiple cashiers going to the same checkout.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Item Stands" to shelves to display the item assigned.[/p][/*][*][p]Added salary info to the Staff app in the phone.[/p][/*][*][p]Added hover and scale animations to the cashier interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more info to the cart items list as well as buttons to remove/add 1 item at a time.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option to order empty boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled player customization interface and added more options.[/p][/*][*][p]Staff now wear similar clothing.[/p][/*][*][p]Every npc can now be right-clicked to view their information.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented player movement after going back to menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the body type 2 prefab not turning walls transparent when behind them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing control popups for the broom.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would make it so changing the wall color would also change the pallet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would make the player be able to call two trucks with the same load.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would bypass the player set sound settings for the thief chase music.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would make customers skip the queue and immediately upload items to the checkout.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would prevent re-hiring staff if fired on the same day.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would allow customers to purchase more items than the allowed maximum.[/p][/*][*][p]Added several checks and fail safes to prevent customers from leaving with items when the store is closed. (99% patched, still some edge cases.)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some texture flickering where road tiles connect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would prevent the initial shelf from being able to be sold.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented being able to enter build mode while main UI panels are open.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would keep a shelf as interactable if it was moved while the player was in focus range.[/p][/*][*][p]Made broom control popups appearance more accurate.[/p][/*][*][p]Resized player interaction collider to be more accurate (maybe, tbh).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented utilities and salaries expenses from bringing the balance below 0.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would break the game on game over.[/p][/*][/list][p]And many, many more small fixes![/p][p][/p][p]//[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Build 0.6.3 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Store Rating Overhaul[/h3][p]The store rating is now managed by an overall rating and three sub-ratings. The overall rating is the average of the three sub-ratings.[/p][p]The sub-ratings each control a specific category:[/p][list][*][p]Variety. Based on the store's item variety.[/p][/*][*][p]Efficiency. Based on the store's staff efficiency.[/p][/*][*][p]Decoration. Based on the store's decoration/cleanliness.[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition, you can now right-click on a customer to view what they are doing and their thoughts on the store. Finally, all review conditions have been re-balanced, but may need further tuning.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Walls and Floor Customization[/h3][p]You can now access new customization options from your store app in the phone.[/p][p]The new customization options include:[/p][list][*][p]10 wall colors.[/p][/*][*][p]3 floor textures.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]This feature is experimental and subject to change. More customization options will be added in future updates.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Italian Localization Update[/h3][p]100% of the game has been translated to Italian.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Changed percentage buttons in price setting to 15% and 30%.[/p][/*][*][p]Cashier workers now only leave when the queue is empty.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an indicator to the cashier interface that shows the remaining queue.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notification counter to the build mode button that shows the amount of furniture in your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a small animation to category buttons in the phone to better show the selected category.[/p][/*][*][p]Collision system overhaul. Collisions are now a lot more accurate when placing or moving furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a small pop animation to furniture when placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Customers will now not consider shelves in the warehouse area of the store.[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of money a customer pays for play tables is now correctly deducted from their money to spend.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notable Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the tutorial localization not updating at runtime.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the furniture inventory not resizing to scroll horizontally when a lot of furniture is displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various text objects no resizing correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented rmb mouse input after going back to menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few issues that caused customers to get stuck in checkout queues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused boxes to get stuck when the player and worker deposited at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed arcades not counting as decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues that prevented the decoration counter from updating correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ceilings not being properly activated/deactivated when loading a save file.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed trash piles not being deleted when switching to another save file.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]
